It provides a cryptographically verifiable audit trail establishing actual notice of the communication regarding a substantial patent portfolio and associated federal disclosures.
attorneys_comments: This RMail receipt provides irrefutable, court-admissible proof of delivery and actual notice (opened/read status) to Polsinelli counsel. Under the Federal Rules of Evidence, specifically FRE 901(b)(9), the detailed audit trail—including IP addresses, HTTP headers, and tracking numbers—authenticates the digital record. Tactically, this precludes any plausible deniability by the recipient regarding the inquiry or the 'Parallel Federal Disclosures' involving SpaceX. If these disclosures contain material risk information, allegations of infringement, or 35 U.S.C. § 154(d) provisional rights notices, this receipt establishes the exact moment the recipient's duty to investigate was triggered. Depending on Polsinelli's relationship with SpaceX, this actual knowledge may implicate ABA Model Rule 8.3 or SEC Material Risk Disclosure obligations. Furthermore, if SpaceX is operating under federal contracts, this notice establishes a timeline relevant to potential 28 U.S.C. § 1498 claims or DFARS 227.7004 administrative demands.
